issue: Hard rectangular brightness seams on the Astra asphalt
diagnosis: Unshaded wetness visualization isolated discontinuities at procedural noise cell boundaries. The sine-based hash field was responsible; the road ribbon and texture mapping were continuous.
fix: Replace sine hashing with a bounded sin-free hash and explicit four-corner smooth interpolation in road_surface.gdshader.
preserved: AmbientCG color, normal and roughness maps
Road geometry, collision, track data and gameplay

verification.observations: Final production baseline has no hard rectangular seams; debug wetness blends smoothly across cell boundaries. No shader compilation or runtime script errors.
